item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows lines $AB$ and $CD$ meeting at $O$. A right-angle mark sits at $O$, and all four angles at $O$ are equal.

What can Arnav conclude?

options.A: Each angle is a right angle, and that label alone is the full conclusion.
options.B: The lines are perpendicular even when they stay apart and never meet.
options.C: The lines are perpendicular, because four equal angles at an intersection are each $90^{\circ}$.
options.D: The lines are perpendicular because the printed word equal is the standout word.
